answer.sent:
No. The Larchpell Highland Wool Throw is dry clean only, so don't machine wash it [P0164].

If you want a throw you can machine wash, two options are listed as machine washable on a cold, gentle cycle:
- Larchpell Heath Blanket Throw, in cotton waffle knit [P0175]
- Emberquay Cosy Wool-Blend Throw, in 60% wool and 40% acrylic [P0165]
